messages:
sam: Short follow-up to the rollout metadata RFC: I'm proposing a tiny canonical shape that keeps pin intent in the control plane but gives clients an ordered candidate list + an epoch counter so caches can detect reorders.

anya: Drop the example please, want to see the exact fields runtime will read.

sam: Example below. Key goals: fast client pick, explicit cache invalidation, and small runtime fast-path hints.

```json
{
  "artifact": "auth-encoder-4b",
  "stamp": "v2026-03-22",
  "stamp_seq": 7,
  "stamp_fingerprint": "sha256:deadbeef",
  "candidates": [
    {"type": "hash", "id": "sha256:aa11", "variant": "fp16", "priority": 0},
    {"type": "stamp", "id": "v2026-03-21", "variant": "int8", "priority": 1}
  ],
  "fallback_policy": "ordered",
  "soft_expiry": "2026-07-01T00:00:00Z",
  "stamp_origin": "canary",
  "preferred_seq_len": 512,
  "runtime_annotations": ["placement:short-seq"]
}
```

rui: Two quick asks: 1) make stamp_seq mandatory so clients re-resolve on bump, 2) require stamp_fingerprint when hashes are referenced so control-plane can't silently remap content.

anya: Agreed. Also standardize that top-level preferred_seq_len is the runtime fast-path and may duplicate client_hints for compatibility. We'll document that clearly.

sam: We'll add a control-plane alert for "fingerprint mismatch on same stamp" instead of auto-blocking. Dedicated tenants can enable `hard_pin` via tenant_overrides which prevents remapping until tenant releases.

devops-bot: schema-check: staging failed because client_hints had mixed types; ticket INF-2205 opened.

rui: Suggest we enforce normalization at ingest: control-plane normalizes numeric hints to numbers and buckets to enums to avoid validator breaks.

anya: And add a short TTL recommendation for stamp lookups so clients know re-resolve cadence. We'll propose 30s-2m depending on tenant SLA.

sam: Action items: sam update appendix with stamp_seq and fingerprint + tenant_override examples (ETA today); anya write cache-ttl blurb (ETA tomorrow); rui add alert rule and hard_pin wiring (ETA 3 days); devops-bot re-run tests after changes.

anya: No objections, please keep the appendix minimal. :thumbsup:

sam: Will merge after edits and ping this thread.

devops-bot: INF-2205 tracked.
